title: Crop Growth Calendars
wikitext:
This page lists crop growth tables for all [[Crops]]. The "Base" table shows growth without the [[Stardew:Skills#Farming|Agriculturist]] profession and without any growth fertilizer. Below each Base table, comparisons between growth fertilizers and the Agriculturist Profession are shown. Note that the increase in growth is 10% with [[Stardew:Speed-Gro|Speed-Gro]] ''or'' the Agriculturist Profession, so the "10%" table applies to each. With the exception of multi-harvest crops, the tables assume that seeds are replanted and watered on the day of harvest. ==Spring Crops== ===Cucumber=== {{main|Cucumber}}
